title: Slot-word statements with passing UI card stacks
summary: Three short white statements on black with blue corner glows; one slot word swaps while stacks of product cards slide across and up through the frame, then split to reveal a glowing card edge and cut to black.
use_when: A service or agent product with a landing page and one dashboard panel to show
Silent social or landing-page loop where type carries the message and UI is texture
Positioning line with one swappable role word (assistant, employee, teammate)
Dark brand with one saturated accent colour for the glow

look.type_style: medium-weight grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, cap height ~5 % H, single centred line; slot word set with a small gap

structure.shot: black; positioning line, 3 words, then a 4th slot word; blue glows light the top-right and bottom-left corners
structure.camera: static (locked frame; the line re-centres as words arrive)
structure.motion: first 3 words blur-in together from 0.27, easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s); slot word blur-in at 0.77, settled 1.00; corner glows fade in over 1.00-1.50 (easings.inOutSine)

structure.shot: cluster of product cards (2 light landing cards + 1 dark editor panel) slides along the lower third left to right; slot word swaps to a 2nd role word and back
structure.motion: dark panel enters from left at 1.50, light cards follow with stagger ~5 fr (±0.25 s), cluster crosses at ~ constant speed (easings.linear) and exits right by 3.25; slot swap at 1.77 (new word drops from above, springs.ui, ~8 fr ±0.25 s), swap back at 3.00

structure.shot: line holds alone with the first slot word; glows shift to the left and right edges
structure.motion: hold 15 fr, line fades to ~0.5 opacity at 3.77 and out by 4.00 (easings.inExpo, ~7 fr ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: 2nd statement, 2 words, built word by word; at 5.00 a vertical stack of cards rises from below through and past the line
structure.camera: static (locked frame; cards travel up ~560 px/s at 1920 wide)
structure.motion: word 1 at 4.00, word 2 blur-in from slightly above at 4.77 (easings.outExpo ~8 fr ±0.25 s); card stack (light, dark panel, light) rises bottom to top 5.00-6.00, easings.inOutSine; line fades under the cards

structure.shot: 3rd statement, 2 words joined by a comma, centred on black with edge glows
structure.motion: word 1 at 6.00, word 2 blur-in at 6.00-6.27 (easings.outExpo ~8 fr ±0.25 s); hold 30 fr; dims at 7.27

structure.shot: cards rise from below and settle into a centred vertical column: light card, dark editor panel, light card
structure.camera: static (column drifts up ~300 px/s at 7-8 s, then holds)
structure.motion: light card rises at 7.27, dark panel follows at 7.50 (stagger ~7 fr ±0.25 s), springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable); column holds 8.00-8.77 with a slow drift

structure.shot: column splits: light cards slide out left, dark panel slides out right, opening the centre
structure.motion: lateral exit ~520 px/s at 1920 wide, easings.inExpo, ~12 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a huge black rounded card fills the lower left with a bright blue rim glow on its top and right edges
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 to ~1.15 over 9.50-10.00 (card moves right and grows), then ~0.5 %/s creep
structure.motion: card enters already large at 9.50, settles at 10.00 on springs.cameraIn (overshoot not measurable); rim glow steady; hold 39 fr

structure.shot: pure black tail, nothing on screen (slot for an end card in a rebuild)

params.content.line: positioning line before the slot, 3 words
params.content.slotWords: 2 role words that swap in the slot (first, second, then back to first)
params.content.cards: 2 screenshots: a light landing hero card and a dark product panel; each reused 1-2 times in the stacks
params.glow.color: accent colour of the corner glows and the rim light (default brand accent)
params.tail: frames of black after the cut (reference 123), or an end card

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (0.25 s). Cards never cover the type for long: horizontal pass along the lower third, vertical pass straight through, then a centred column. Glow sits in two opposite corners and moves between rows. The 4.1 s black tail after the cut is empty in the reference. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): card-stack-pass, corner-glow. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
